text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "CROSS", "gist": "CROSS (Coordination Of Scenarios for SWEET)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SWEET", "gist": "SWEET programme"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "EPF Zurich", "gist": "Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "DeCarbCH, EDGE, PATHFNDR and SURE", "gist": "four consortiums"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "CoSi", "gist": "CoSi consortium"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "CROSS a terminé ses activités début 2023 et se poursuit désormais en tant que CROSS+", "gist": "CROSS ended activities in early 2023 and continues as CROSS+"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "L'objectif de CROSS est de garantir que les analyses de scénarios soient comparés de manière pertinente et que des conclusions fiables puissent en être tirées.", "gist": "CROSS aims to ensure scenario analyses are compared meaningfully and reliable conclusions are drawn"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Les principales tâches de CROSS consistent à harmoniser et documenter les hypothèses de travail, les scénarios simulés et leurs résultats, et à les rendre accessibles au public.", "gist": "CROSS's main tasks are to harmonize and document working assumptions, simulated scenarios and their results, and make them publicly accessible"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "appel d’offre 1-2022", "gist": "Call for tender 1-2022"}]}
